incident_time: 21:08 2022 MIAMI GRAND PRIX 5 - 8 May 2022 Car 20 - Kevin Magnussen The Stewards, having received a request from Haas F1 Team, agree to extend the time specified in Article 38.2 a) i) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations by 1 hour and 20 minutes, due to the delayed availability of the FIA personnel required to unseal the replacement power unit.
